decisions_boundary: Averaging the scalar Fourier kernel does not average the physical cumulant, path boundary, orientation sum, or positive connected excess. Tests verify exact finite identities only.

physical_source_correction.finite_principal_section_path: for closed lag path r with prefixes q_j, span ell=max(q)-min(q), valid roots are [k_- - min(q), k_+ - max(q)]; exact path correction is -(1/m)*sum_{k in I but invalid for r} exp(i*T*Y+2*pi*i*k*Y/L), with magnitude <=ell/m<=4R/m
